title: Talent Acquisition Consultant
description:
Talent Acquisition Consultant

Recruiter

Oldbury

Automotive

Hybrid

12 months Interim

Client Details

Michael Page are excited to partner with a nationwide leading organisation based in Oldbury to appoint for a 12 months interim Talent Acquisition Consultant role.

This role can offer hybrid working of 3 days office and 2 home per week.

This is a superb opportunity to join a growing team on a 12 months interim based with possible scope for a permanent position in future.

Description

Working as part of a busy team, the role of Talent Acquisition Consultant will involve taking responsibility for the full recruitment life-cycle of high-volume roles. You will play a vital role in the continuous growth and success of this division of the organisation

Duties will include but not limited to:
- Manage end-to-end recruitment activity for roles such as mechanics and field operatives, from vacancy briefing through to offer stage.
- Work with hiring managers to understand role needs and agree clear recruitment plans.
- Proactively source and engage suitable candidates through a wide range of recruitment channels.
- Review applications and coordinate interview processes to maintain a smooth and engaging candidate journey.
- Use data analysis to support with continuous improvement to the hiring process
- Support with a range of projects to further support candidate attraction and engagement

Profile

Ideal applicants for this role will demonstrate:
- Experience recruiting for high-volume roles within a similar sector
- Ability to work with hiring managers and build excellent stakeholder relationships within large, complex, multi-site organisations
- A proactive and innovative approach to candidate attraction and engagement

Job Offer
- 12 months fixed-term contract - with possible scope for permanent in future
- Up to 50,000pa
- Bonus
- Hybrid working - 3 days onsite and 2 home per week
- Exciting opportunity to play a vital part in the continued growth and success of an organisation

title: Learner Resourcer
description:
Learner Resourcer (Apprenticeship Department)
Contract Type: Full Time, Permanent
Location: Wolverhampton (Bushbury)
Salary: £25,000 - £27,000 pa (depending on experience, skills & qualifications)
Are you looking for a new role?
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as a Learner Resourcer. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administrative skills and telephone experience.
As a Learner Resourcer, you'll play a vital part in this exciting process, supporting the recruitment team with a diverse range of tasks.
Working as part of our team you will be responsible for identifying and sourcing candidates for the recruitment process to fulfil the requirement of the business roles.
Key Responsibilities:
- Search and resource candidates via apprenticeship website, job sites and social media platforms
- Conduct telephone interviews, shortlisted candidates to evaluate their skills, experience, career goals
- Completing candidate application forms, obtain prior attainment checks, delivering and documenting high quality Information Advice Guidance (IAG)
- Ensuring that candidates are supplied to Employer Engagement Team in a timely manner
- Booking Maths and English invigilation.
- Have awareness of other coordinators vacancies in order to refer suitable candidates
- Liaise with Employment Engagement Team to ensure vacancy outcomes are timely and KPI s are achieved

Requirements:
- Minimum of 2 year s experience in a similar role
- Experience in resourcing candidates
- Level 2 qualification in Business Admin/Customer Service or equivalent
- Confident communicator with a polite telephone manner
- Are able to work as part of a team
- Reliable and Punctual
- Good energy and positive vibes
- Ambitious

Employee Benefits:
- 25 days holiday entitlement increasing to 30 with length of service,
- Holiday Purchase Scheme, allowing you to purchase an additional 2 weeks holiday per year.
- Day off for your birthday.
- Optional early finish on a Friday
- Dress down Friday
- Employee Assistance Programme, 24/7 support for you, direct family members and dependents over the age of 16.
- Employee Referral Scheme, potential to earn up to £500 if you refer somebody we employ.
- Cycle to Work Scheme.
- Employee Discount Scheme Significant savings on essential and everyday purchases through instant vouchers, reloadable cards and cashback.

Nova Training places the highest priority on safeguarding all of our learners and staff. We are a Safer Recruitment employer, job applications will be subject to detailed scrutiny. Applicants for all jobs will undergo appropriate screening including identity checks with past employers, Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check and entitlement to work in the UK will be verified as part of our further recruitment process, following a face-to-face interview.
All relevant employment documents will be seen and verified. NB: Only original or certified documents are acceptable. Applications for employment must be made on the NTS1d Employment Application Form which you will be sent if you are called for an interview.
Nova Training receives a high number of applications for each role advertised and although we would like to, we are not always able to deliver feedback to unsuccessful candidates. If you have not been contacted within 7 days then unfortunately your application has been unsuccessful. Thank you for your interest and please do take a look at our website and Indeed for future opportunities.

title: Resourcing Consultant
description:

This is a site based role, working Monday to Friday which is scheduled to run until the end of December 2026.

Key Responsibilities:

About You:
